verdict.rationale: Antigravity's IDE product page says its Editor view offers "tab autocompletion", which covers the inline-completion half of the story. That is only a one-line marketing claim with no depth. The pack has no evidence of next-edit suggestions and no hands-on corroboration of completion behavior. Missing for 10: documented next-edit suggestion capability, in-depth docs on how completions trigger and are configured, independent or hands-on confirmation of inline completions.
